lead: A small neighbourhood beside the Besòs, born in 1929 as a public housing development, with metro line 1.
text: In 1928 the Patronato de la Habitación (a housing trust) bought land beside the Besòs from the Marchioness of Castellvell, and in 1929 the neighbourhood was built, with 344 detached family houses between the river, the Renfe workshops and the Besòs industrial estate. Its name is that of the Baron of Viver, mayor of Barcelona during the Primo de Rivera dictatorship: the Republic renamed it Pi i Margall and the Franco regime restored the original. Since 2009 it has been part of the Pla de Barris de Baró de Viver i Bon Pastor; the civic centre on Carrer de Quito, of 1,652 m², opened in March 2015, and the Pla de Barris 2025-2028 allocates 14.5 million euros to Trinitat Vella, Bon Pastor and Baró de Viver together.

Today, with 2,668 inhabitants in 0.23 km², it is one of the smallest neighbourhoods in Barcelona, at the eastern end of the Sant Andreu district, and Baró de Viver station on metro line 1 connects it with the centre and with Santa Coloma de Gramenet. It was renovated in 1985 after its special interior reform plan was approved, and in 1989 the Gran Salón housing complex, by the architect Emilio Donato, was built. With limited housing supply, 1,801 €/m² and 555 €/month, its prices are among the lowest in the city. If you are selling, the average sale price is 48% below the Sant Andreu average. Within the neighbourhood, the price of each flat depends on its condition, its floor and its building, so it is best to compare it with nearby sales rather than with the district average. If you are buying, an 80 m² flat costs about 144,000 € on average, and this is one of the most affordable neighbourhoods in Sant Andreu (7th of 7 by price). If you are investing, the average rent is 39% below the district; before deciding, it is worth studying each deal with real figures for purchase, renovation and rental income.
housing: Family houses from 1929 and later blocks, such as the Gran Salón complex, in a small neighbourhood with very limited supply.
places: Estació de metro Baró de Viver (L1)
